title: feat(nm2simt2x): simultaneous M and O freeze t+1 vs t+2 on two-axis opposite x-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD, composition HOLD
science: Simultaneous freeze t+1 vs t+2 on opposite x-probes. Records the aligned-seed artifact at D too: O(D,t)={-e_1} is already non-empty because the neighbour (0,1,0) is a seed whose letter -e_1 points from D into it.
